capabilities: Show a home dashboard with quick search, folder cards and a clock
Manage a local .ics calendar with month, week and day views
Connect Microsoft, Google, CalDAV, ICS and IMAP accounts and turn mail into notes
Open an e-book bookshelf and market quote panels
extras: First run auto-installs NyaLingo (needs network, then one reload); IMAP mail is desktop only; authorization codes are stored AES-256-GCM encrypted with a machine-local key; the README includes donation links.
problem: Obsidian's entry point is scattered across the file explorer, search and separate plugins, with no single page for the day's events, mail and tasks.

relations.evidence: mail and note translation use the shared NyaLingo plugin
a button in the home header opens the NyaReader bookshelf
install the separate NyaHome Mobile plugin to share local calendars, sketches, stars and task boards

summary: Unified home page with quick search, folder cards, clock, local .ics calendar, Markdown task boards, optional mail and calendar services, plus e-book and market panels.
